text:
oliver: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: the inference outage flagged three recurring gaps — missing regression prompt sets, no dedicated load testing for tail latency, and no chaos drill for fallback routing. We need owners + target dates for remediation and tests. Postmortem: https://redwood/pms/infra-2026-02 (see TL;DR).
incident-bot: Postmortem created: infra-2026-02 (link above) — severity 2 — action items assigned in tracker RDW-4213.
tess: I can own prompt-set curation and the regression additions. Target: draft prompt sets + eval harness PR by 2026-04-08. Will scope smaller first pass (20 prompts per failure mode).
ajay: I’ll take load tests. Need to validate Dedicated pool configs + sustained QPS profile. Will spin up a canary JMeter job and an airflow DAG. Target: load test infra + baseline run by 2026-04-05.
noah: I’ll run the chaos drill (routing & model-fallback). Need SRE window and a readout. Propose week of 2026-04-12 for the drill.
devx-bot: Created tasks — RDW-5231 (prompt sets), RDW-5232 (load-tests), RDW-5233 (chaos-drill). Linking to repo: github.com/redwood/evals/tree/rdw-5231.
sre-oncall: Noted recurring pattern: failures happen mid-day during cross-region failover. Recommend we include cross-region throttling scenarios in load tests and simulate partial KV cache loss in the chaos drill. Also +1 to week-of-04-12.
tess: rough checklist for prompt-set PRs:
```
- include failing and near-failing queries (n>=20)
- expected output tags (pass/soft-fail/hard-fail)
- reference postmortem snippet for context
- unit test that runs locally in CI (10s timeout)
```

ajay: For load tests, initial config I'm planning:
```
- dataset: prod traces sample (last 7 days)
- concurrency: 50/100/200 (10m holds)
- measure: p50/p95/p99 tail latency, mem/GPU util, kv-cache hit rate
- model variants: full fp16, int8-ggml fallback
```
noah: Chaos drill runbook items I want: rollback to fallback model, kill 1/3 KV cache nodes, induce region latency. Need owners for monitoring hooks (traces/alerts).
oliver: Assigning monitoring hooks to ajay for load-test dashboards, tess for regression alert integration (evals->console), noah for drill runbook doc. Please confirm + add due dates to the RDW tasks.
tess: confirmed. Adding evals alert mapping and golden-prompt tags to RDW-5231. ETA 2026-04-08.
ajay: confirmed. RDW-5232 will include dashboards + a post-run report template. ETA 2026-04-05.
noah: confirmed. RDW-5233 runbook first draft by 2026-04-09, drill week 2026-04-12.
oliver: Great. I'll collate these into a single follow-up doc and ping PM/legal if we need an expanded SLA note. One more ask: include a short regression gating rule so that any model rollback must pass the new prompt-set suite before prod.
sre-oncall: +1 on gating. For the drill I recommend we keep blast radius low and have immediate abort criteria (p99 > 5s or error-rate > 1%).
oliver: Summarizing action items (brief):
- RDW-5231 prompt sets — tess — 2026-04-08
- RDW-5232 load tests + dashboards — ajay — 2026-04-05
- RDW-5233 chaos drill runbook — noah — 2026-04-09 (drill week 2026-04-12)
- Monitoring/alerts hooks — ajay/tess/noah — link into console and postmortem ticket RDW-4213
Please add any blockers here. :thumbsup:
tess: minor blocker — need a list of failing examples from the inference logs. @oliver can you drop a small export?
oliver: I’ll upload a redacted export to the RDW tasks by EOD today.
ajay: FYI we might need a short Dedicated pool resize permission from infra for the 200-concurrency run — creating infra request in RDW-5232.
noah: Will coordinate SRE run window and invite ops to the drill.
devx-bot: Reminder: weekly follow-up check-in scheduled every Wednesday 10:00 PT until all RDW-523x tasks are closed.
oliver: Thanks all — I'll close the loop after I update RDW-4213 with these owners and dates. If anything changes, flag here or update the RDW tickets.
